map.财务（利润/现金流/报表）核算 使用指南: Finance (Profit / Cash Flow / Statements) Accounting User Guide
map.输入利润与现金流数据（逗号或换行分隔），汇总合计、均值与波动并输出报表要点，辅助: Enter profit and cash flow data (comma or newline separated) to total, average and measure the variability, and output the key report points, which assists business review and financial analysis.
map.月度经营复盘把 12 个月的净利润贴入，看合计、均值与波动，判断盈利是否稳定。: A monthly business review pastes in the net profit for 12 months to see the total, the mean and the variability, and judge whether profit is stable.
map.对比两条业务线的现金流，用离散程度看哪条更可预测。: Compare the cash flow of two business lines and use the dispersion to see which is more predictable.
map.汇总多个项目的回款金额，找出明显偏离均值的异常项目。: Aggregate the collections across projects to find any project that clearly deviates from the mean.
map.：贴入 12 个月经营现金流得到合计 486 万、均值 40.5 万、标准差 1: Pasting in 12 months of operating cash flow gives a total of 4,860,000, a mean of 405,000 and a standard deviation of 128,000; the total indicates scale and the large standard deviation means some months have large inflows and outflows, so watch the receivable terms and the collection rhythm.
map.均值与中位数背离: When the mean and the median diverge
map.：12 个月利润均值 40 万、中位数 28 万：均值明显高于中位数，说明少数月: The 12-month profit mean is 400,000 and the median 280,000: the mean is clearly above the median, so a few high-profit months pulled it up; the normal level of profitability should be judged from the median.
map.输入数据用什么分隔？: What separator should I use for the input data?
map.支持逗号或换行分隔；页面只做数值统计，单位与口径需自行统一（如统一为万元）。: Comma or newline separated; the page only does numerical statistics, so you have to unify the units and basis yourself (such as everything in ten thousand CNY).
map.能生成完整财务报表吗？: Can it generate complete financial statements?
map.不能。页面输出的是描述统计（合计、均值、极值、波动）与报表要点，正式报表仍需按会: No. The page outputs descriptive statistics (totals, mean, extremes, variability) and the key points of a report, but formal statements still have to be prepared under the accounting standards.
map.可以。现金流或利润为负（净流出/亏损）会一并纳入统计，判读波动时要结合业务背景区: Yes. A negative cash flow or profit (net outflow / loss) is included in the statistics too, so read the variability together with the business context to separate out seasonality.
